title: Public Pathway Consolidation v5r2: minimal identified mechanism
summary: PPC5r2 reduces the first controlled mechanism rung to a four-operation frozen policy, one isolated evidence-gated READ-LoRA, explicit post-selection response interventions, total frozen-DREAM context and root policies, and closed life-level reducers. It tests four separate component claims without treating candidate-conditioned selection as storage or their conjunction as mediation.
system_thesis: An Experience Model should eventually learn from its own verified life and improve future cognition. PPC5r2 tests only the smallest identifiable substrate: supported-record selection from an external candidate table, recurrent use of every edge in a decisive path, frozen same-model DREAM context selection, and DREAM-guided selection of evidence for a READ adapter. Rich thought, learned DREAM, learned policy, continual improvement, parenting, populations, and scaling remain separate later hypotheses.

acceptance_tests.setup: Hash-bind all normative files; complete two fresh interpretations, critique, consensus, and exact human architecture/scope ratification.
